notes.title: Nightfall Hacker goes free for Linux on the Snap store
notes.content:
Nightfall Hacker, a recently released brand new indie game release from James Harvey of Teradile has now become free for Linux users via the Snap store.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/03/nightfall-hacker-goes-free-for-linux-on-the-snap-store

notes.title: Update March 11
notes.content: Just made the tutorial a little more obvious.

notes.title: Nightfall Hacker is a turn-based strategy homage to The Nightfall Incident
notes.content:
Some of our older readers might know The Nightfall Incident, an early 2000s game available on the LEGO website. The overall idea was revived in the homage Nightfall Hacker that's out now.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/03/nightfall-hacker-is-a-turn-based-strategy-homage-to-the-nightfall-incident
